Shen Miao, the Di daughter of a military family, was pure, quiet, gentle, and gracious. Because of her foolish love for Prince Ding, she forced her way into becoming his wife.
After six years of assisting her husband, she finally became the mother of the world: The Empress.
She had stayed with him during the fight for dominion over the empire and during the efforts to expand its territory. She even went so far as to put herself in danger and be taken hostage by a neighboring empire. In spite of this, when she returned to the Imperial Palace five years later, she no longer had a place in the Imperial Harem.
That beautiful woman he kept in his embrace gave her a bright, stunning smile and told her, “Older Sister, the country has settled down. It is time for you to step back as well.”
Her daughter died tragically and her son the Crown Prince was deposed. No one in her Shen family, who had been completely loyal to the Emperor, were spared. With arrival of a new reign, everything was overturned! 
Shen Miao never thought that all of the perils they encountered as husband and wife, all of the assistance they gave each other mutually, were nothing but a joke in his eyes!
He told her, “Because you have been with this Emperor for more than two decades, this Emperor will allow you to keep an intact corpse. You should be grateful for this kindness.”
Beneath a meter of white silk, Shen Miao established a malicious oath: Once the day of reckoning arrives, every single one of you will die!
Once reborn, she returns to the year when she was only fourteen years old, a time when tragedy has not yet befallen, when her family still lived, and when she was still the pure, quiet, gentle, and gracious Di daughter of a military family.
Close relatives conceal evil intentions, her cousins are vicious and merciless, the new concubine is like tiger watching its prey and that s*um wants the previous life’s events to be repeated?
Her family must be protected, the great enmity must be avenged, and the prize must include the empire’s imperial throne. In this lifetime, let us see who comes out on top!
But that Xie Family’s young marquis, that tyrannical and arrogant spear-wielding young man on horseback, stays stubbornly on her side and proudly declares, “It is merely toppling the Imperial Family. Do not forget, the world belongs to you, and you—you belong to me!”
–
The Thirteen Capitals of You Zhou: This belongs to you.
The Ding Yuan City in the North Desert: This belongs to you.
The Southern River of Yu Zhou, the Eastern Sea of Ding Xi, the Green Lakes of Lin’an, the Ancient City of Luo Yang: All of these belong to you.
“Xie Jing Xing, if all of this belongs to me, then can you tell me what you want?”
“Alright, I want you.”

In the most quiet and unobtrusive manner possible. How? By accident.
Mo Qing, one of her lowest ranking lackeys at that point in time, had killed her after he retrieved the demon sword and unintentionally unleashed the sword’s demonic aura onto the heavily injured Lu Zhao Yao.
Her quiet and untimely death, coupled with her firm belief that Mo Qing had sneakily betrayed her by lying in the shadows and waiting to strike the final blow and reap all the rewards, nurtured a heavy grievance within her. Lu Zhao Yao refused to head to the underworld and reincarnate, hanging around in the human world in her spirit form.
Lady Luck, however, had not completely abandoned her.
One fine day, a female disciple of the Immortal Sect (Zhi Yan) fought with her childhood friend and banged her head onto Lu Zhao Yao’s grave. To Lu Zhao Yao’s utmost delight, she was able to possess Zhi Yan’s body for short periods of time after this.
Thus began her journey to avenge her very own death by destroying Mo Qing——and, in the process, resume her rightful place as the King over all demon sects!

“Shen Lingyu, isn’t it too lonely to be alone? Why not take me with you?” he asks.
“Wasn’t it you who warned me to stop having designs on you?” she retorts.
“That was just a ploy to capture your heart,” he admits with a charming smile.
Despite her initial reluctance, Shen Lingyu finds herself drawn to his persistence and charm. As she navigates her new life, she must decide whether to trust him and embrace the possibility of love.
associated_names: 被休后，当朝首辅跪求入赘

109106.synopsis:
Gu Jinnian transmigrated into the world of an urban wish-fulfillment novel, becoming a prestigious villainous young master. He even obtained an acting system. As long as he followed his plotline steadily, he could return to reality with mysterious rewards, marry a rich and beautiful woman, and reach the peak of life! Gu Jinnian felt this was wonderful! However, after experiencing numerous absurd and mindless plots, Gu Jinnian’s Dao heart completely collapsed.
[President Tong Yun truly is a conservative ice queen. It’s such a hot summer day; doesn’t she know how to dress a bit cooler?] [Ha! Worthy of being the protagonist’s young aunt, her clothes are so white.] 
[Eh? Why isn’t the crooked-mouth protagonist here yet? Was he hit by a car? Speaking of which…]

109618.synopsis:
I was reincarnated as a child of the Warenjar family, one of the insignificant noble houses, said to be among more than a thousand baronial families. 
To be frank, I was far from a winner – I was the very definition of a minor noble. Not the head of a chicken, but rather the dung at the rear of a cow, position-wise. 
However, since I had lived a modest life in my previous world, I strangely found comfort in that position. With my cultivated waste-not mentality and money-saving techniques, I somehow became beloved by family and friends, and while being misunderstood by those around me, I went on to solve many problems. 
From my waste-not spirit, I gained unique skills, and before I knew it, I started getting nicknames like “The Frugal User of Artifacts,” but it seemed I couldn’t stop my small-time noble behavior.
associated_names: The Life of a Small-Fry Noble Seems to Suit Me

110386.synopsis:
Having traversed into a high martial arts world for eighteen years, Ye Feng knew the importance of strength. Relying on his own efforts, he ranked among the top students at Martial Arts No. 1 High School.
During a Sea Beast Battle, Ye Feng fought so hard that his Martial Arts Foundation was damaged. By slaying a large number of Sea Beasts, he painstakingly earned first place.
With such an achievement, he could be recommended for admission to Longteng Academy, which was his only hope to heal his damaged foundation.
Unexpectedly, his results were swapped. He had no way to appeal and was even falsely counter-accused, his alleged crime made worse, and he was expelled from the academy!
Just as Ye Feng was filled with rage, his Golden Finger, eighteen years late, finally arrived.
【Ding!】
【’Treasure Chest Opening Spree’ System binding successful!】
【Countless Treasure Chests randomly appear all over the world. Seek them out to open treasures: Cultivation Methods, Martial Skills, Divine Weapons, Sharp Tools, Spirit Pills, Miraculous Medicines, Cultivation Insights, Talent Physiques… Anything that exists in the world has a chance of being obtained.】
【You opened a Colored Treasure Chest and obtained an SSS-Grade Physique: Martial Dao Saint Body!】
【You opened a Golden Treasure Chest and obtained 999,999 Card Qi and Blood!】
【You opened a…】
From then on, Ye Feng was either opening Treasure Chests or on the way to open Treasure Chests. His strength advanced by leaps and bounds, and all enemies would face retribution tenfold, a hundredfold!
Many years later, Extraterrestrial Civilizations watched covetously, their armies at the gates.
Ye Feng: “Don’t panic, I’ll open a Treasure Chest first.”
Click!
【Heaven-defying luck! Obtained one hundred thousand units of the Power of Law!】
With a flick of Ye Feng’s finger, billions of civilizations were instantly destroyed.
Invincible!

An estimated 100 or more additional unconfirmed killings are suspected.
[Response] To be executed immediately upon capture without trial.

113202.synopsis:
In his previous life, Lin Luochen was imprisoned to death because of a disastrous entanglement with the Holy Maiden of the Jade Maiden Sect.
In this life, he severs all ties of love and devotes himself solely to the Dao—yet fate has other plans.
A demonic enchantress lights karmic fire on her fingertip:
“You sure remember clearly where my cinnabar mole is.”
The Holy Maiden of the Jade Maiden Sect points a frosty sword at him:
“You shattered my Supreme Emotionless Dao, and now you think you can just walk away?”
A nation-toppling beauty smiles sweetly:
“Only you, my dear husband, know me inside and out.”
Lin Luochen backs away step by step:
“Ladies, this is all a misunderstanding! I swear I’m not your husband!”
The women sneer in unison:
“Lin Luochen, don’t think we don’t know you’ve been reborn. Still trying to play dumb?”
Lin Luochen flees for his life, clutching his head:
“All I want is to become an immortal ancestor and make all other immortals bow before me! I want nothing to do with love or romance!”
The enchantress licks her lips:
“So, hubby, you do like this kind of thing? You should’ve said so earlier!”
As Lin Luochen looks at the swarm of beauties chasing after him, he suddenly realizes with horror—
This life might end even earlier than the last…

114738.synopsis:
Old Master Huo, who commanded overwhelming wealth and power, suddenly had a biological daughter of unknown origin; the adorable little one was soft and sweet.
From then on, the Overbearing CEO became a doting father!
“My darling is willful and reckless, I spoiled her!”
“My darling is arrogant and presumptuous, I indulged her!”
“Whatever my darling says is right!!”
Not only that, even all the bigshots rushed to spoil her:
“Little darling, come be our little princess, you can do whatever you want in Kyoto!”
Old Master Huo angrily retorted: “Luo Luo only has me as a father, all of you get lost!”
With great difficulty, he chased away a group of scoundrels who were competing for his daughter.
Unexpectedly, in a blink of an eye, his precious daughter was actually snatched away by that wolf-hearted little rascal!!
————
Kyoto Prince Si Yang was rebellious and lawless.
He drank the strongest liquor, fought the fiercest fights, and drove the fastest cars.
Everyone thought no one in this world could control this little tyrant.
Until one day—
Everyone saw this always lawless master surprisingly meekly coaxing a delicate little girl.
“Luo Luo, don’t cry, I’ll give you my life, okay?”
associated_names: I Became the Big Bosses Daughter
I Became the Bigshot's Biological Daughter

115506.synopsis:
In my first year of middle school, a girl faked a love confession to me, and it ended with bullying from other girls.
In my second year, my mom confessed she had cheated and that I wasn’t my dad’s real son. Then they got divorced.
Living with a father I wasn’t related to felt suffocating, so I left home and started going to high school on my own.
Now I’ve completely lost trust in girls. Honestly, I think girls are the worst, and I go through my days feeling that way.
“Hey, hey, what are you reading today?”
 “Why are you even talking to me?”
 Seriously, just leave me alone.
Note: The story aims to be light but may sometimes get a bit heavy.

※ Please note that this work is set in a fictionalized version of South Korea in the year of 2005, and any resemblance to real people, places, companies, or events is coincidental.
Two years ago, after his father’s accident, Danyoung lost everything in an instant and, against his will, ended up at the dabang. The work isn’t hard, thanks to the few customers who visit the coffee shop, but life is tight when trying to cover the growing interest on his debt.
Dabang (다방): A traditional Korean tea room or coffee shop, distinct from modern cafes. In the past, and in fiction, they are sometimes depicted as seedy places or fronts for illegal activities.
The problem is that even if he wants to find another job, the loan company won’t let him. Danyoung can only guess that the dabang he’s tied to is no ordinary place.
Then one day, a man who seems to both fit and not fit in at the dabang barges into …
“What are you doing?”
“……”
“Why are you just standing there like a little pipsqueak? Are you blind?”
From that day on, the man starts showing up at  whenever he feels like it.

124210.synopsis:
The man approached again, lifting his foot to press against that fragile neck, calculating how much force it would take to snap it.
Lu Qingchen had prepared himself to grovel in the dirt, but even then, he never imagined Shen Junhuai would leave him no way out.
“I didn’t mean to board that ship. I didn’t, I swear! I’ll never do it again, please-”
Tears choked his voice as he crumpled forward, fingers clutching Shen Junhuai’s sleeve.
For the first time in his 30 years, Shen Junhuai drowned in a tidal wave of regret and agony so visceral it threatened to tear him apart.
ML: Shen Junhuai — Cold, detached, and ruthlessly dominant.
MC: Lu Qingchen — Gentle, broken, and achingly submissive.
A story of unequal power, brutal mistakes, and the redemption that comes too late.

136242.synopsis:
Chu Xi is the entertainment industry’s most notorious “white lotus”—her face is the most beautiful, her demeanor the most coquettish, and her haters the most numerous. Rumor has it that even the mysterious tycoon backing her is the wealthiest of them all.
Until she receives a terminal illness diagnosis.
Thinking that two years together must have fostered some affection, Chu Xi tearfully seeks comfort from her patron.
Yet the man merely scoffs at her tears, casually tearing up her diagnosis report. “Save your crocodile tears,” he sneers. “We were never about feelings.”
——
It’s common knowledge in the industry that Chu Xi has powerful backing. But recently, her resources have plummeted, her public image has drastically shifted, and she even resorted to smashing bricks barehanded on a variety show for attention—shattering her delicate “white lotus” persona overnight.
The entire entertainment industry cheers as Chu Xi is finally dumped, her hypocritical facade exposed before being unceremoniously cast aside by the mysterious tycoon.
Until one day on set, an extra films a scene where Chu Xi uses a stunt double for a kissing scene.
Meanwhile, the real Chu Xi is being dragged away by the same tycoon, who coldly pins her against a wall by the waist and kisses her fiercely.
associated_names: 全娛樂圈都以為我是嗲精_魔安

145458.synopsis:
Tags: [Genderbender Yuri] 
No one mourned for even a second after legendary pilot Ao Lie’s crash.
The first to arrive at the crash site was the saintess, Auriel.
Perhaps it was Ao Lie’s wild liftoff that flung the entire world to the Ashen Continent, where every person now has a random assigned identity.
“Shh! Play your role well. Don’t let those around you find out who you really are. Otherwise, the devout—and furious—believers will tear you apart.”
The system’s voice echoed in the minds of billions who crossed over.
And so the survival game began.
But Ao Lie just laughed when he heard it.
Roleplay, huh? Sounds fun.
Although… it’d be even better if my gender hadn’t changed.
Well—actually, this is fine too.
Hehe. I’m going to live.
